control: OFF disables only the new dynamic CNN residual. Original LoRA, original CNN and native A conditioning remain active in both modes.
provenance: New Internet content and artwork images; no ces or training-dataset assets opened for this evaluation. This does not prove their media categories were absent from training.

observations: Etched portrait has monochrome/sepia paper and fine line texture, but smile, beard and face orientation drift.
Pastel portrait remains relatively photographic and lacks a strong powder-pastel appearance.
Etched dogs keep count two, but golden coats and head orientations change substantially; much color remains.

Pastel dogs visibly show powder-like edges and dry strokes at original resolution, but flowers intensify and dog shapes change. Source already contained flowers, so increased flowers alone do not establish semantic copying.
Pointillist landscape has painterly short strokes and canvas-like texture rather than faithful organized pointillism; lake/reflection structure becomes a waterfall and new objects appear.
Ink landscape has ink-line/paper/dilute-color response, but also invents waterfall and small figures/buildings.
Pointillist plant becomes a general painted drawing with dark outlines, not clear reference pointillism; pot changes.
Ink plant has paper, thin uneven outlines and dilute green washes, but leaf layout and pot change and pseudo-writing/marks appear.
Poster car simplifies the background and reflections but keeps blue shaded vehicle; the limited-color silhouette language of A is weak and vehicle details change.
Cyanotype car remains a blue car with green trees, not a blue-ground pale contact-print image.
Poster coffee has clear flattened color blocks and outlines, while cup/hand/milk relationship remains recognizable; exact four-color poster palette is not faithfully transferred.
Cyanotype coffee stays a colored flat illustration with skin and coffee hues; cyanotype medium is not transferred.

dynamic_increment: At overview and selected full-resolution inspection no stable visible improvement of medium-specific brushwork or texture from ON versus OFF was established.

pixel_change.meaning: Mean absolute RGB pixel change only; not style quality, separation degree, gradient strength or causal mechanism.

limitations: Two contents per artwork reference, not exhaustive generalization coverage.
Visual observations are qualitative, not calibrated percentages.
No claim about training-data absence of the six medium categories.

qa.material: All three completed round overviews and full-resolution dogs_pastel, landscape_pointillism, portrait_etching predictions.
qa.independent_conclusion: Some real medium/texture response exists, especially powder-pastel dogs and paper/ink plant; pointillism and cyanotype fidelity fail, content drift remains substantial. OFF and ON are visually near-identical across all twelve pairs, with no stable added dynamic-CNN benefit established.
qa.root_assessment: Agree with the pictured findings. For lake/waterfall replacement and invented figures, the outputs establish content reconstruction/drift; they do not alone prove that all invented objects were copied from reference A.
